Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 6
Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer prematurely fixed on two gyms (“Muscle Headz Gym” and “Pleasant Valley Wellness Center”) without verifying their exact locations, categories, or completeness against the “in West Virginia” and “within 5 miles by car” constraints. Subsequent steps show no concrete distance outputs from mapping tools (only input actions), yet the agent later asserted verification and produced a final answer. This assumption-based selection and lack of validated driving-distance evidence led to a potentially incomplete/incorrect solution.
